jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Position Title:
Operations Manager

Pay Rate :
$80,000 - $101,000
Multiple factors, including Individual experience, skills and abilities will determine where an employee is ultimately placed in the pay range. Variable pay may provide additional opportunities for financial awards. This job is eligible to participate in IP’s annual incentive plan.

Category/Shift :
Salaried Full-Time Exempt

Physical Location:
3558 2nd Street North
Minneapolis, MN

The Job You Will Perform:
The Operations Manager will be responsible for the Customer Service and Shipping Departments and report directly to the Complex General Manager. This position is responsible for, but not limited to the following:

- Responsible for providing overall direction and leadership to the customer support team.   Improve efficiency, profitability, and customer satisfaction by implementing service and operations strategies.   In addition to business improvement, provide team members with challenging work and developmental objectives, and will share both responsibility and accountability in the attainment of organizational goals.

- Act as a front-line decision maker, managing major and significant customer accounts; some having enterprise agreements.

- Provide significant process and/or product expertise and be a subject matter expert resource for other team members.

- Receipt and processing of requests for price quotations, purchase orders, order changes, adjustments, and cancellations.

- Provides supply chain and replenishment leadership for facility customers

- Tracking forecast accuracy, defining inventory and safety stock standards

- Efficiently scheduling facility production demands

- Managing order requirements through an outside sales organization and offsite customer service organization

- Manage commercial price updates including price list, trackers, audits and communication to customers / commercial team

- Daily Shipments – Plant backlog understanding by customer.   Work directly with Production to understand machine loading, booking and schedule loads.   This includes communicating internally and externally timing of shipments.

- Manage third party freight logistics, Customer HUB / PORTAL requirements and IP freight systems

- Manage third party Warehouse

- Trailer optimization and minimization

- Support Lead Team objectives such as Safety, Engagement and EBIT

- In addition to daily operational responsibilities, the successful candidate will be responsible for implementing and maintaining systems, driving manufacturing improvements as well as leading, coaching, motivating and engaging the work teams to accomplish operational objectives.

The Skills You Will Bring:
- A relevant degree in Business Administration or Operations Management is preferred with at least five years’ experience in manufacturing in the corrugated industry.

- Minimum of 5 years of demonstrated supervisory and leadership experience required.

- Leadership experience in Shipping and/or Customer Service required.

- Strong organizational skills and ability to react to operational support requirements must be able to organize time effectively and prioritize tasks to cope with fluctuating workloads.

- Ability to lead, coordinate multifunctional teams, and collaborate with other departments, customers, and business partners.

- Demonstrated leadership ability to drive results and influence others to meet department objectives.

- Must demonstrate a proven track record of date accurate data entry; proficient skills in Excel, Word and Outlook; ability to learn industry and customer specific computer systems. KIWI knowledge plus.

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Manager
jobs.description:
Position Title: Continuous Improvement Manager
Pay Rate:
$101,000 to $134,600 (USCORE)

Multiple factors, including Individual experience, skills and abilities will determine where an employee is ultimately placed in the pay range. Variable pay may provide additional opportunities for financial awards. This job is eligible to participate in IP’s annual incentive plan.
Category/Shift:
Salaried Full-Time
Physical Location:
5032 S Davy Crockett Pkwy
Morristown, TN 37813
The Job You Will Perform:
The Continuous Improvement Manager (CIM) is responsible for establishing and sustaining a high-performing operating environment that embeds continuous improvement principles across the manufacturing facility. This role provides strategic leadership for quality systems, safety performance, and operational excellence while ensuring compliance with regulatory and customer requirements. The CIM partners closely with plant leadership to drive measurable improvements in safety, quality, reliability, and productivity.
- Lead the development and execution of continuous improvement strategies across manufacturing operations.
- Drive adoption and effective use of manufacturing reliability and continuous improvement tools (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, problem-solving methodologies) to improve safety, quality, throughput, and cost.
- Coach and influence supervisors and operating teams to build capability, accountability, and ownership of performance metrics. The CIM will manage a manufacturing department and be responsible for leading a team of supervisors to achieve operational goals.
- Provide support by leading the plant safety team.  Also, support safety initiatives such as safety audits, incident investigations and safety orientation for new hires.  Must understand OHSA/EPA regulations.
- Provide overall leadership and governance of plant quality systems, ensuring alignment with internal standards, customer requirements, and regulatory expectations.
- Manage internal audit programs, including audit scheduling, execution, corrective action tracking, and continuous improvement of audit outcomes
- Actively participate in the New Item process, as well as Customer audits and communication. Maintain knowledge of customer specific quality testing, expectations, and requirements.

The Skills You Will Bring:
- Bachelor’s degree required.
- 5–10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, quality, or continuous improvement leadership roles. Demonstrated knowledge and experience in developing, implementing and managing high performance work systems and teams
-  Knowledge of and compliance with local and corporate policies
- Builds Effective Teams
-  Business Insight
- Drives Results
- Customer Focus
- Manages Complexity
- Optimizes Work Processes

The Operations Manager will be responsible for the Customer Service, Scheduling and Shipping Departments and report directly to the Site Manager.   This position is responsible for, but not limited to the following:

- Managing order requirements through an outside sales organization and offsite customer service organization

- Support Lead Team objectives such as Safety, Engagement and EBIT

In addition to daily operational responsibilities, the successful candidate will be responsible for implementing and maintaining systems, driving manufacturing improvements as well as leading, coaching, motivating and engaging the work teams to accomplish operational objectives.

The Operations Manager is responsible for leading the Customer Service, Scheduling, and Shipping departments to ensure efficient supply chain operations, inventory management, production scheduling, and on-time delivery performance. Reporting directly to the Site Manager, this role drives operational excellence by optimizing materials, improving manufacturing processes, supporting business objectives, and leading teams to achieve safety, engagement, customer service, and financial performance goals. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership, organizational, and analytical skills, along with manufacturing experience and the ability to collaborate across functions to deliver results.
